name: manual_59e4c4
claim: When a Claude session budget is the binding constraint, route implementation to codex exec with workspace-write scoped to the worktree and keep Claude seats as thin supervisors that verify the diff and own the commit: the quota is independent and the sandbox scope doubles as a safety guardrail.

decisions.notes: Adopted on 2026-08-14 after a six-agent Claude workflow died on a session usage limit having consumed roughly 290k subagent tokens for zero completed agents. codex exec supports read-only, workspace-write, and danger-full-access sandboxes; invoking it with workspace-write and -C pointed at a worktree means it structurally cannot reach a global root such as the user skills directory, so the budget fix and the blast-radius fix are the same decision. The supervising seat still gates: it verifies the diff and runs the commit, so codex writes but never lands work unreviewed.
